findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:1539 treats every non-null findings payload as schema-valid, allowing contract-invalid vendor output to bypass recovery and count toward quorum; this occurred in this review when the Codex payload used an invalid axis value.
findings.resolution: Validate the complete parsed payload against review-findings.schema.json, including limits and item enums, before returning schema_valid; route all validation failures through invalid-output recovery.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_routing.py:48 falls back to static routing whenever callers omit a resolver, so normal direct, pull-request, and autopilot review calls never apply the required reviewer archetype and premium model mapping.
findings.resolution: Provide and wire a default coordinator/local reviewer resolver, preserving explicit > phase > reviewer default > static-only-after-resolution-failure precedence.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_attempts.py:180 ends after the requested vendor's local chain, while the production dispatcher never schedules the contract-required one undispatched replacement vendor or transfers its original logical slot.
findings.resolution: Implement deterministic round-level replacement selection, slot transfer/cancellation, the replacement's bounded local chain, and distinct-vendor single-vote accounting.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_attempts.py:166 checks the deadline only before an invocation and accepts an over-budget success after the call returns, so an attempt that exceeded the logical deadline can become quorum-eligible.
findings.resolution: Re-check the monotonic deadline after every invocation, convert overruns to terminal timeout evidence, and avoid rounding a sub-second remainder into a new one-second subprocess budget.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:1546 rejects the dispatcher's own auth_required enum value and rewrites it to unknown, losing the contract-required terminal auth classification and provenance.
findings.resolution: Normalize ErrorClass.AUTH to the review-attempt contract value auth before recording the attempt and add terminal-auth regression coverage.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:1926 writes only legacy success fields and derives quorum from ReviewResult.success, dropping logical attempt chains, sanitized diagnostics, terminal outcomes, and shared eligibility from CLI manifests.
findings.resolution: Persist each full validated logical result and compute quorum_received with the shared eligibility predicate while retaining legacy aliases.

findings.description: Critical: skills/autopilot/scripts/convergence_loop.py:519 consumes the generated consensus dictionary without the required relational validate_consensus_report() checks, and no implementation of that validator exists in the change.
findings.resolution: Implement validation for legacy/canonical aliases, nested/flat quorum consistency, eligible-vendor counts, and blocker-count invariants; invoke it before persistence and convergence decisions.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_policy.py:29 accepts arbitrary actor_type=human strings and an approval_ref as sufficient accepted-risk authorization, allowing edited or fabricated artifact data to suppress a live convergence blocker.
findings.resolution: Require a trusted approval resolver to verify authorization mechanism, reference, actor, and integrity; keep the finding blocking whenever trusted verification fails.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:332 uses union-find connected components, so a weak A-B/B-C bridge merges A and C even when they do not meet the grouping threshold, undercounting blockers and misattaching future adjudications.
findings.resolution: Use deterministic anchor/clique admission that requires each description-only member to meet threshold against the anchor and every existing group member.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:387 always evaluates an unreviewed adjudication and emits an empty applied ledger, leaving no path to validate, reject, or apply fixed, false-positive, accepted-risk, or deferred records as required.
findings.resolution: Load an adjudication ledger keyed by stable group and concern fingerprints, validate evidence and authorization, reject stale or unknown entries fail-closed, and emit the applied entries.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/consensus_synthesizer.py:323 performs quadratic cross-vendor matching without enforcing the contract's 500-finding and 2 MiB per-vendor limits before synthesis.
findings.resolution: Reject and recover over-limit vendor payloads during result validation before constructing match edges.

findings.description: Critical: skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/review_dispatcher.py:1695 rejects every non-null SDK thinking request even though SdkConfig defines thinking_parameter and thinking_values, so supported provider configuration is ignored rather than translated and applied.
findings.resolution: Translate supported SDK thinking through configured parameter/value mappings and fail only when the requested value cannot be represented; record requested and applied values per attempt.

findings.description: Critical: skills/autopilot/scripts/convergence_loop.py:533 escalates solely on historical disagreement status, so a future valid non-blocking adjudication would still be escalated despite the contract saying adjudication resolves the policy blocker without erasing history.
findings.resolution: Escalate only unresolved disagreements whose policy remains convergence-blocking, not every item retaining historical disagreement status.
